_comment: A fictional harness, shop-harness (CLI word shop, env prefix SHOP). Copy to <harness>/zylos/manifest.json and replace every value; zylos/README.md "The manifest" explains each key; runtime.uv_installer_url is a placeholder for Astral's installer of uv_version.
name: shop-harness

tasks.name: shop-hourly-stock
tasks.prompt: Hourly stock sync: run {cli} pull stock, then {cli} ingest stock. Both exit 0: call done, report nothing. Either fails: send the owner the error lines, then call done.

tasks.name: shop-daily-sync
tasks.prompt: Daily order sync; run only these commands. Start the detached pull: {detach} pull-orders -- shop pull orders. Then every 5 minutes run tail -n 5 {log:pull-orders} until it ends with a {exit} line; then run {cli} ingest orders. A log still without {exit} after 90 minutes counts as failed. The log ends {exit} 0 and the ingest exits 0: call done, report nothing. Anything else: send the owner the error lines, then call done.

tasks.name: shop-nightly-stories
tasks.prompt: Nightly story checks; run only these commands: {cli} facts list --json, then for each entry of its "declared_markets": {cli} compute stories --json --market <M>. Send the owner exactly one line per market in the owner's language: the pass, fail and skip counts, then each failed story's id and its reason worded from reason_code. No market declared, or a command that exits non-zero or prints no JSON: send the owner that and its error lines instead. Then call done.
